text:
viv: starting a cascading cohort 'safety-braid' for ff:llm-prefetch-opt at 23:50 UTC. objective: reduce cold KV misses w/out hurting token accuracy. plan is micro -> scale -> soak -> scale. cohorts: canary-a(1%), team-beta(5%), public-stage(20%), public(50%). cadence 8m steps, 3m soak. runtime lock=v2.6.0 for rollout to avoid kernel drift.
samir: copy. what are our hard triggers?
nic: hard rollback if p99 increases >70ms OR customer error-rate >0.6% in any cohort. pause if token-accuracy (TOK_ACC) drops >1.12x baseline across two soaks. abort immediately on OOMs.
viv: I'm enabling verbose sampling + token diffs for first 12m. will push examples to #model-audit.
deploy-bot: safety-braid scheduled for ff:llm-prefetch-opt. cohorts: canary-a(1%), team-beta(5%), public-stage(20%), public(50%). start=1766666000 step=8m soak=3m runtime_lock=v2.6.0. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-602
support-bot: rollout tag added: rollout/prefetch-opt. support channel #support-watch notified.
samir: please add a one-line release blurb for triage.
viv: release-note: "llm-prefetch-opt: smarter prefetch + KV warmup to cut cold-path latency; staged safety-braid rollout with runtime lock v2.6.0. Watch p99, TOK_ACC, and OOMs."
nic: rollback throttles and yank commands:
```
# full immediate stop
/feature toggle ff:llm-prefetch-opt off --now
# scale a cohort back to zero
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-prefetch-opt public 0
# drain a cohort and annotate for QA
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-prefetch-opt public-stage --tag "drain-for-analysis"
```
alerts-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p99-prefetch (70ms threshold, eval 5m) -> alerts to #eng-oncall + #eng-releases. monitor/oom-events critical. monitor/tok-acc-drop (1.12x) -> notify ML + this channel.
viv: decision policy: 1 alert -> pause further scaling, collect traces + run a focused A/B for 20m. 2 alerts OR any OOM -> rollback to previous feature state and open rollback ticket. runtime lock remains until ML signoff.
samir: if we pause, keep runtime locked to avoid mixed-binaries. also keep sampling on for 30m.
nic: starting canary-a in 3m. @deploy-bot please post cohort changes here.
deploy-bot: cohort canary-a enabled (1%) at 1766666185. event_log: cohort=canary-a, runtime_lock=v2.6.0.
nic: sampled 400 outputs -> TOK_ACC baseline=0.965 current=0.963 (within noise), p99 delta +9ms. no OOMs.
samir: dashboards look OK. I'll watch customer error-rate and make sure support is looped.
alerts-bot: heartbeat: no active alerts.
viv: moving to team-beta in 8m if no guardrail hits. quick note: if a cohort shows a localized regression, we may remove that cohort only and proceed elsewhere (cascade-safe). fallback: route traffic to legacy variant v2.5.x if capacity or regression persists.
nic: logs will tag suspicious examples with #prefetch-anom. exporting flagged examples to runbook ticket.
support-bot: reminder: change window closes at 01:00 UTC. if we stop mid-rollout, open rollback ticket with tag rollback/prefetch-opt and ping CSMs for affected customers.
viv: thanks team. concise updates at each cohort step. :eyes:
